items.title: Investigational CRISPR therapy succeeds in patient with drug-resistant E. Coli
items.summary: The CRISPR therapy, SNIPR001, was administered to the patient who had developed E. Coli following a single-patient emergency IND.

items.title: Infinimmune raises $75m with big pharma backing for atopic dermatitis drugs
items.summary: Infinimmune is targeting first-in-human studies with its longer-lasting monoclonal antibodies in 2027.

items.title: Epicrispr, Vaderis secure pivotal study funding for rare disease assets
items.summary: Epicrispr and Vaderis have secured $90m and $152m, respectively, to take their rare disease drugs to pivotal clinical development.

items.title: Mereo BioPharma and Sentynl Therapeutics sign licensing deal for alvelestat
items.summary: Mereo BioPharma and Sentynl Therapeutics have signed an option and licence agreement related to the US commercial and worldwide manufacturing rights to alvelestat, a potential oral treatment for AATD-LD.

items.title: Alfasigma signs agreement to acquire Nordic Group
items.summary: Alfasigma is to buy Nordic Group, which aims to strengthen its speciality care business and expand its reach in Europe, Canada, and Japan.
